bullets.text: Kawaii Audio Player Delight - **HiBy** collaborates with **Hatsune Miku** for a vibrant digital audio experience.
Revolutionary Lidar Sensors - **Ouster** unveils 'Rev8', merging color imagery with depth information in one sensor.
AI in Emergency Rooms - A **Harvard** study shows AI outperforms human doctors in emergency diagnoses.
Free VPN in Firefox - **Mozilla** integrates a free VPN into **Firefox**, enhancing user privacy without extra costs.
AI Music Surge - Streaming platforms face an influx of AI-generated music, raising concerns among artists.
Sony's Table Tennis Robot - **Sony** introduces Project Ace, an AI robot capable of competing in table tennis.
Smart Speaker Revival - **Google** prepares to launch new smart speakers alongside its Gemini platform.
Digital Polaroids Innovation - **VidaBay** launches NFC-enabled digital Polaroids, allowing endless photo updates.
